claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Etilefrine is a hydrophilic sympathomimetic adrenergic agonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; it lacks DNA-damaging, tubulin, kinase-inhibitory or other cytotoxic activity, and its only measurable cellular interaction is weak inhibition of organic cation transporters at much higher concentrations.
